p: acquired the privilege to … water drip … he has acquired the privilege to … water pour … he acquired the privilege to … water pour

acquired the privilege to let water drip from his roof into his neighbor’s courtyard, he has acquired the privilege to let the water pour there through a drainpipe. If the neighbor did not protest about the water dripping from the roof into his courtyard, he would certainly allow him to build a drainpipe, which would limit the water to a single place.
